import json, sys, itertools
def svcs(n):
    return [{'name':'S%d'%i,'label':i+1} for i in range(n)]
LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def big_policy(nwords, plen=4, slen=4):
    names = ['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
    pre = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=plen))[:nwords]
    suf = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=slen))[:nwords]
    words = [tuple(list(p)+list(s)) for p,s in zip(pre,suf)]
    return 'startswith() allow;' + ''.join('match(%s) drop;' % ','.join(names[c] for c in w) for w in words)

kind = sys.argv[1]
out = sys.argv[2]
jobs = []
if kind == 'inspect':          # 16 images, ~200k inspects -> huge output
    ev = [{'op':'stage','epoch':e,'policy':'match(S%d) allow;'%e} for e in range(1,17)]
    ev += [{'op':'inspect'}] * (200000 - 16)
    jobs = [{'services':svcs(16),'limits':LIM,'events':ev}]
elif kind == 'stages':         # 8 MiB policy bytes, 16 stages, huge images
    ev = []
    for e in range(1, 17):
        ev.append({'op':'stage','epoch':e,'policy':big_policy(3800 if e==1 else 1)})
    ev += [{'op':'inspect'}]*100
    jobs = [{'services':svcs(16),'limits':LIM,'events':ev}]
elif kind == 'events':         # 200k mixed lifecycle events
    ev = [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':big_policy(2000)},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
    for u in range(1, 9):
        ev.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,u,1],'service':'S%d'%(u%16)})
    rid = 0
    i = 0
    while len(ev) < 199990:
        rid += 1; i += 1
        u = (i % 8) + 1
        ev.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,u,1],'rid':rid})
        ev.append({'op':'send','unit':[0,u,1],'rid':rid,'connection':[1,1],'stream':i,'destination':'S1'})
        ev.append({'op':'recv','connection':[1,1],'stream':i,'unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid,'wire':None})
        ev.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,u,1],'rid':rid})
        ev.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
        if i % 97 == 0:
            ev.append({'op':'inspect'})
            ev.append({'op':'store','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':0,'file':[1,1]} if False else {'op':'inspect'})
    ev = ev[:200000]
    jobs = [{'services':svcs(16),'limits':LIM,'events':ev}]
elif kind == 'huge':           # 4 jobs, near 24 MiB input
    jobs = []
    per = 48000
    for j in range(4):
        ev = [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':big_policy(800)},
              {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
              {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'S0'},
              {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'S1'},
              {'op':'open','connection':[1,1]}]
        rid = 0
        while len(ev) < per:
            rid += 1
            ev.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
            ev.append({'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid,'connection':[1,1],'stream':rid,'destination':'S1'})
            ev.append({'op':'recv','connection':[1,1],'stream':rid,'unit':[0,2,1],'rid':rid,'wire':None})
            ev.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
            ev.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':rid})
        ev = ev[:per]
        jobs.append({'services':svcs(16),'limits':LIM,'events':ev})
elif kind == 'limits':         # every limit touched
    ev = [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'startswith() allow;'},{'op':'commit','epoch':1}]
    for u in range(1, 1025):
        ev.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,u,1],'service':'S0'})
    ev.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'S0'})
    for u in range(1, 1025):
        ev.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,u,1],'rid':1})
    ev.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':2})
    ev.append({'op':'inspect'})
    jobs = [{'services':svcs(16),'limits':LIM,'events':ev}]
json.dump({'jobs':jobs}, open(out,'w'))
PYEOF
